Extra read-only folders you may use: handoff-docs, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fqq-Desktop-Topflightapps-roundai/2a408671-6ff1-4104-9d24-9f97da7d0ee6/scratchpad/cr/review-evidence

Scenario TC-13/S29 — Retention windows are configuration values, not hard-coded

Requirements it checks:
- T7: Every 3.6 retention window is a configuration value, not hard-coded, so it can be lengthened under a hospital affiliation without a code change.

Given: The read-only worktree of main (round-companion-wt-qa) and the 3.6 window list
When: For each 3.6 window, find where its value comes from. Hospital: pre-round, Important Points, encounter, note, previous note, vitals/labs/imaging, medication rows, open tasks, completed tasks. Nursing Home: pre-round, encounter, note, last two visits
Then: Every window is read from a configuration value (deployment setting or a settings row), so it can be lengthened without a code change
Oracle: UAT 3.6 ('All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded') + TFA-94699 AC 7. A window defined only as a code constant is a Fail of T7; main defines HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION as consts, so a Fail is expected. Optional later, once a configuration path exists: an api-lane check that sets the pre-round window to 24 h on the local stack through that path and confirms the pre-round text survives the 13 h point (needs the aging helper)

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

Open questions the oracle defers to, with the oracle's default for each (do not settle them yourself):
- (none)

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):
- known:windows-consts — HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION are code consts (matrix: "main defines HOSPITAL_RETENTION and SNF_RETENTION as consts, so a Fail is expected")

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
For each UAT 3.6 window, find where its value comes from: Hospital pre-round, Important Points, encounter, note, previous note, vitals/labs/imaging, medication rows, open tasks, completed tasks; Nursing Home pre-round, encounter, note, last two visits. List each window with file:line and its value in answer.

pass = every window is read from configuration (a deployment setting or a settings row) and can be lengthened without a code change
fail = any window is only a code constant

Other halves of this scenario that another lane or a person runs (do not judge them; if the code you read predicts one of them, report that as a finding labelled half:<name>, supports = pass or fail):
- (none)

Not part of this verdict (other scenarios, or notes that decide nothing here):
- the optional api-lane check once a configuration path exists (needs the aging helper)



Label every finding:
- new: a failing point the matrix does not already record (supports = fail)
- known:<id>: exactly one of the recorded gaps listed above
- pending:<id>: a failing point whose verdict the oracle hands to one of the open questions above
- half:<name>: a point about one of the other halves above
- context: background, not for or against the verdict

Answer with: verdict (pass | fail | pending | unsure), answer (a short paragraph a QA lead can read: what the code does and why that is the verdict; name the recorded gaps and open questions it touches), findings (each with claim, file, line, quote, supports = pass | fail | context, label), physicianImpact, openQuestions, notDecidableByCode.
